notes.title: Solution For Video Crashes
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We've noticed that a few players are experiencing issues with animations causing the game to freeze or crash. To address this, we've introduced an alternative animation system using image strips, which should help prevent these issues. You can also choose to disable animations entirely if needed.

Note: If you're not experiencing any issues with the animations, there's no need to change your current animation settings.

To switch to the new animation system:
[olist]
 Go to the main menu and click on Settings.
 Select Video Options.
 Under Animation, choose "Strips."
[/olist]
Please let us know if this solution works for you.

With Love, 
The Love-Joint Team.

notes.title: Small patch for the Gallery
notes.content:
Hi there,

We just released a small patch to fix a bug with Gallery persistence data across different save profiles (previously, Gallery data was always being stored in the Default profile).

We’re still hard at work investigating the crashes and the achievements not unlocking on macOS. We’ll have more updates soon!

Cheers!

notes.title: Mark Your Calendars: Shale Hill Secrets Hits Steam May 8!
notes.content:
After a whole lot of sweat, tears, and hard work, it’s finally time to announce the official release date for Shale Hill Secrets here on Steam — and it’s coming sooner than you might think!

On May 8th, next Thursday, the full game will be available right here on Steam for everyone to enjoy!

🚨 Exclusive Launch Discount!

To celebrate the release, Shale Hill Secrets will be 15% off during launch week (the first 7 days). Don’t miss your chance to grab it at a special price!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42003585/41bd4c7d303fd3e6a8e7a95b12b92cf8139feea6.png

And now, a huge thank you to everyone who’s already added the game to their wishlist — your support and patience mean the world to us. Haven’t wishlisted it yet? Now’s the perfect time! That way, you won’t miss our big Steam debut on May 8th.

Spread the word!

We’re a small indie team, and every bit of support helps us out. Want to give us a hand before launch?

 Add Shale Hill Secrets to your Wishlist — the more wishlists we have, the better our visibility at launch!
 Follow our Steam page so you’ll get notified the moment the game goes live.
 Share our Steam page with friends, on forums, Discord, or social media — especially if you know someone into adult visual novels.

Your support really does power indie creators like us!

We can’t wait to welcome you on launch day. Thanks so much for your support and patience. We hope you’re as excited as we are for our very first Steam release!

All the best,
Love-Joint Team

notes.title: Shale Hill Secrets development update | 2
notes.content:
Hello everyone, how's it going?

Just dropping in to say hi and share an update on the game - we're in those final adjustment stages for our Steam release. Being our first time launching here, we've hit a few more hurdles than expected with the process as a whole...

Also, since our game has some, let's say, "spicier" content, we're having to be extra careful with everything. The good news is that development finished up several weeks ago, and we're really close to seeing it pop up in the store! 

All the best and thank you for your patience and support!

Love-Joint team

notes.title: Shale Hill Secrets development update
notes.content:
Hey everyone, how's it going?

We wanted to say hello and let you know we haven't forgotten about Steam! We're still working and adjusting some things to launch the game here. Unfortunately, we’re having some headaches that every game developer faces along the way…

To be more specific, some parts of the game's original code need updating and reworking for this platform, but it's nothing too serious and we're already finishing up with all of that. We're also taking the opportunity to touch up the animations, remastering all of them, increasing the videos resolution, improving the loops, and, especially, tweaking the sound effects.

Anyway, we're a very small team and some tasks end up taking more time than we expected, but the game is 95% ready for Steam and very soon we'll have a launch date.
Stay tuned and thanks for your interest!
